maria: Quick sync — following yesterday's RFC I want to propose we replace the lease/escrow handoff with a lightweight 'sigchain' handshake for progressive rollforwards. Can we do a short sync?

ajay: Sigchain? TL;DR please.

maria: Chain of signed commits: controller -> candidate -> router. Each step appends a signature + probe digest. Verifiable head, easy rewind. Example (pseudo):
```
prev = 0x00
entry = {epoch:42,nonce:7,meta:...}
sig = HMAC(controller_key, prev || entry)
chain.append({entry, sig})
```

sasha: How do we handle router restarts / duplicate appends? idempotency model?

maria: We include epoch + monotonic nonce in each entry. Routers check tail hash+nonce; if they see same epoch with higher nonce they ignore older entries. Also TTL on entries to avoid stale tails.

ajay: Sounds heavier than current lease. Any perf impact on p99 path?

lee: Only verify full sigs on the control-plane path. Data-plane routers verify only the chain head hash (blake2s) and trust the head if recent. Use blake2s for cheap verification.

sasha: Emergency fallback: when candidate degrades, auto-rollback should pick fallback model that matches contract. Do we have policy hooks?

maria: Proposed policy: candidate is scored by latency delta, error rate, and quality regression. If combined score > threshold -> immediate rewind to verified head. Last-good checkpoint kept in local mem + durable S3 snapshot. Score formula example: `score = w1*latency_pct + w2*error_rate + w3*quality_drop`.

deploy-bot: :rocket: canary started: candidate=v2.3 sigchain_id=abc123 epoch=42 region=us-west-2

ajay: Need operator CLI: `sigchain inspect <id>` and `sigchain rewind <id> [--force]`. Also `sigchain tail` to show head summary.

lee: Observability needs: chain length, avg verify time, head age per router. Proposed metrics: `sigchain.verify_ms`, `sigchain.head_age_seconds`, `sigchain.chain_len`.

tanvi: From product POV — must avoid visible user errors during switch. Do we plan cache warmup or shadow traffic before append?

maria: Yes — hidden probe lane. Warmup traffic marked `probe=true` and routed to candidate but not counted in sigchain score until we append the first signed probe digest. Warmup helps KV caches and L2s.

sasha: Edge case: partial commit across regions. Need to support regional partial rollouts — signatures must include region scope so rollforwards can be independent.

maria: Exactly. Namespace sigchain by region: id = region || epoch || nonce. Router will reconcile per-region head.

ajay: Next steps: spike for verifier service + CLI, router patch to check head-hash only, metrics dashboard, and auto-rollback hook. Assign owners?

maria: I'll own verifier spike and RFC followup PR (will add state machine diagrams). @lee please do metrics + router patch. @ajay you own ops CLI and rewind safety checks. I'll draft the rollout policy weights for review.

lee: :thumbsup: I'll mock a Grafana panel for the metrics.

sasha: Thanks — please drop the RFC link and PR in this thread so we can track.
